SELECT t.id, t.ticket_no, t.title, t.description, t.resolution_summary, t.resolution_steps, t.resolution_verified, t.category_id, t.priority, t.status, t.creator_id, t.assignee_id, t.team_id, t.due_time, t.completed_time, t.closed_time, t.overdue, t.tags, t.create_time, t.update_time, t.create_by, t.update_by, t.deleted FROM ticket t WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.overdue = 0 AND t.due_time IS NOT NULL AND t.due_time < #{now} AND t.status IN ('PENDING_ASSIGN', 'PENDING_PROCESS', 'PROCESSING', 'PENDING_CONFIRM') ORDER BY t.due_time ASC, t.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ticket ( id, ticket_no, title, description, resolution_summary, resolution_steps, resolution_verified, category_id, priority, status, creator_id, assignee_id, team_id, due_time, completed_time, closed_time, overdue, tags, create_by, update_by, deleted ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{ticketNo}, #{title}, #{description}, #{resolutionSummary}, #{resolutionSteps}, #{resolutionVerified}, #{categoryId}, #{priority}, #{status}, #{creatorId}, #{assigneeId}, #{teamId}, #{dueTime}, #{completedTime}, #{closedTime}, #{overdue}, #{tags}, #{createBy}, #{updateBy}, 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE ticket SET ticket_no = #{ticketNo}, title = #{title}, description = #{description}, resolution_summary = #{resolutionSummary}, resolution_steps = #{resolutionSteps}, resolution_verified = #{resolutionVerified}, category_id = #{categoryId}, priority = #{priority}, status = #{status}, assignee_id = #{assigneeId}, team_id = #{teamId}, due_time = #{dueTime}, completed_time = #{completedTime}, closed_time = #{closedTime}, overdue = #{overdue}, tags = #{tags}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE ticket SET overdue = 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND overdue = 0

mapper.select:
SELECT u.id AS user_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.nickname, ''), u.username) AS user_name, COUNT(1) AS completed_count, AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, t.create_time, t.completed_time) / 60) AS avg_process_duration, SUM(CASE WHEN t.overdue = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overdue_count FROM ticket t INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = t.assignee_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE AND t.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND t.completed_time IS NOT NULL AND t.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'CLOSED')
GROUP BY u.id, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.nickname, ''), u.username) ORDER BY completed_count DESC, avg_process_duration ASC LIMIT #{limit}
